name: Jun An Kang Group Inc.
summary: Interact Holdings Group, Inc. engages in trading and distributing green products to residential builders and developers. It brands include Diverse Networks and UTSI International. The Diverse Networks is an infrastructure services provider specializing in comprehensive machine to machine (M2M) hardware and software solutions. The UTSI International is a systems engineering, integration, and consulting firm focusing on automated system design, implementation, and project engineering services. The company was founded on May 8, 2001 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
